names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 31 octombrie, «Sfântul Apostol Aristobul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 31 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιοι Στάχυς, Απελλής, Αμπλίας, Ουρβανός, Νάρκισσος και Αριστόβουλος οι Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 16 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свети апостол Аристовул.“, with Свети left off, which is not a rank, and with the rank word апостол left off. The heading gives no epithet and no see — Britain is in the body — so the bare forename is what the source gives.

Read out of the title on his name link behind the line for 31 октября ст. ст., «Апостол из 70-ти Аристовул», with the rank words left off; the line declines it, «Аристовула», and the day's kontakion prints the same nominative. The folder's `sr` form from the Ohrid Prologue is the same word, «Аристовул», and the two calendars are recorded separately.

feast.note: A second day on this calendar, recorded here because one row per church is the schema. His name page gives «Дни памяти: 4 января (70 ап.) , 16 марта , 31 октября» — the synaxis of the Seventy, the day the Ohrid Prologue keeps him on and this folder's Serbian row already carries, and this one. The day page's own life for the six sends the reader to the first of them for his account, «О святом Аристовуле сведения помещены 16 марта», so 16 марта is where this calendar tells his life and 31 октября is where it lists him with the five; the row is written for the day page that lists him, per the brief, and he does not render on 16 марта.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Апп. от 70-ти Стахия , Амплия , Урвана , Наркисса , Апеллия и Аристовула (I).»
source.note: The line is the first of the day. The day carries one typikon sign only, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком», so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: **The Russian is the one of the four calendars that says nothing about him on his own day.** Its life for the six closes «О святом Аристовуле сведения помещены 16 марта» — his account is placed at 16 March — and that day was not read here, because this row is for the day page that lists him. So the row brings the day, the name form, the century from the line's «(I)», and the day's two hymns, the kontakion naming him third of the six. The folder's Serbian row is on that same 16 March, from the Ohrid Prologue, and the two calendars agreeing on the second day is worth having. His name link gives him no see, where the Greek and Romanian gave him Britain.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 31ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Στάχυς, Απελλής, Αμπλίας, Ουρβανός, Νάρκισσος και Αριστόβουλος οι Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 31 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own, one of the six apostles of the Seventy kept together on this day. The page gives him no see — it says only «και αυτός υπήρξε επίσκοπος», he too was a bishop — so the folder's office, Bishop in Britain, comes from elsewhere and is not touched. The page names a second day for him, «βλέπε σχετικά και την 15η Μαρτίου», and that is this note and not a second row. No year, so the folder's dateless state is unchanged. Both hymns name all six and are taken into all six folders. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 29.03.2026 (16. март ст. ст.) — „Свети апостол Аристовул.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, and plainly this apostle: one of the Seventy, brother of the apostle Barnabas, born in Cyprus, a follower of the apostle Paul who mentions him in the letter to the Romans, and set by Paul over Britain as its bishop — which is the office this folder already carries. The Romanian and the Greek keep him on 31 October, in a line of six of the Seventy together; the Prologue keeps him alone on 16 March, and two churches keeping one man on two days is ordinary and is not a second feast on one church. The entry gives no year of any kind, so the folder stays undated, as it was. `related` rows go both ways to `barnabas-the-apostle`, whose brother the entry makes him, and to `paul-the-apostle`, who ordained him and names him in the epistle: both are this saint's own story and not furniture. The stored form is the bare forename, because Свети is not a rank, апостол is one this folder's `types` already carry, and the heading gives no epithet and no see. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Sfinţilor Apostoli, rugaţi pe Milostivul Dumnezeu, ca să dea iertare de greşeli sufletelor noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfinților Apostoli Apelie, Stahie, Amplie, Urban, Aristobul și Narcis, Glasul 3

english.text: Holy Apostles, entreat the merciful God that he may grant our souls forgiveness of our offences.

hymns.text: Τὴν κιθάραν τοῦ Πνεύματος τὴν ἑξάχορδον, τὴν μελῳδήσασαν κόσμῳ τὰς ὑπὲρ νοῦν δωρεάς, ὡς ἐκφάντορας Χριστοῦ ἀνευφημήσωμεν, Στάχυν Ἀμπλίαν Ἀπελλῆν σὺν Ναρκίσσῳ Οὐρβανόν, καὶ Ἀριστόβουλον ἅμα· ὡς γὰρ Ἀπόστολοι θεῖοι, χάριν αἰτοῦνται ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος πλ. α’, Τὸν συνάναρχον Λόγον — the second hymn on the page of the six. It names all six of them and no other saint.

english.text: Let us praise the six-stringed lyre of the Spirit, which sang to the world the gifts that are past understanding, as the revealers of Christ — Stachys, Amplias, Apelles with Narcissus, Urban, and Aristobulus together; for as divine Apostles they ask grace for our souls.

hymns.text: Ὡς ἱερὰ κειμήλια, τοῦ Παναγίου Πνεύματος, καὶ τοῦ Ἡλίου τῆς δόξης αὐγάσματα, χρεωστικῶς ὑμνήσωμεν, τοὺς σοφοὺς Ἀποστόλους, Ἀπελλῆν Οὐρβανόν τε καὶ Ἀριστόβουλον, Ἀμπλίαν Νάρκισσον καὶ Στάχυν, οὓς ἡ χάρις συνήγαγε τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, Ὡς ἀπαρχὰς τῆς φύσεως — on the page of the six. It names all six of them and no other saint.

english.text: As sacred treasures of the All-Holy Spirit and rays of the Sun of glory, let us hymn as we are bound the wise Apostles — Apelles and Urban and Aristobulus, Amplias, Narcissus and Stachys — whom the grace of our God gathered together.

hymns.text: Апостоли святии,/ молите Милостиваго Бога,/ да прегрешений оставление// подаст душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь апостолов». The text is the common of the apostles and names none of the six; it is the same text the Romanian page prints for the day, and it is copied whole, as the brief directs.

english.text: Holy apostles, pray to the merciful God that He may grant our souls forgiveness of our sins.

hymns.text: Яко священная сокровища Всесвятаго Духа/ и Солнца Славы сияния,/ по долгу воспоим мудрыя апостолы,/ Апеллия, Урвана же и Аристовула,/ Амплия, Наркисса и Стахия,// яже благодать собра Бога нашего.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак апостолов». It is the Slavonic of the Greek kontakion this folder already holds, and it names all six of the day's apostles.

english.text: As sacred treasuries of the All-Holy Spirit and rays of the Sun of Glory, let us sing as we ought of the wise apostles — Apelles, Urban and Aristobulus, Ampliatus, Narcissus and Stachys — whom the grace of our God gathered in.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 31 октября ст. ст. closes the six apostles with «(I)», and its life for them is titled with the same «(I)» — the first century. The folder held no `dates` before this; none of the other three calendars dated him.
